Name: Rezin, King of Syria
Summary: Rezin, king of Syria, allied with Pekah against Ahaz, besieged Jerusalem without taking it, took Elath for Syria, and was slain when Tiglath-Pileser took Damascus.
KeyStory: Rezin besieges Jerusalem and is slain at Damascus.
RelatedPeople: Pekah, King of Israel; Ahaz, King of Judah; Tiglath-Pileser, King of Assyria; Isaiah
LifeLesson: A siege that fails still leaves its mark, and its maker still falls.
